name: Hot Ross

features.name: Ro$$ and Hot Ro$$
features.description: Expanding wild cats; Hot Ro$$ also drags neighbouring Ro$$ symbols into full reels.

features.name: Wild multipliers
features.description: Expanding through a wild adds a multiplier of up to 200x.

features.name: Activated reels
features.description: In Nine Lives, a reel that lands Ro$$ keeps landing one every spin.

review:
Hot Ross brings back Ro$$ the cartoon cat from R.I.P. City for a sequel with three bonus rounds. Regular Ro$$ symbols expand down to the bottom of their reel, while Hot Ro$$ symbols fill the whole reel and pull Ro$$ symbols on the neighbouring reels up so they expand fully too.

When either version expands through an ordinary wild, it picks up a multiplier of up to 200x that covers the whole expanded reel. The Nine Lives bonus adds activated reels where a Ro$$ lands on every spin for the rest of the round, which is where the 15,000x maximum becomes realistic. Expect long quiet stretches between the moments when two or three reels catch fire together.
